name: Slack Audit Logs
description: Collect audit events from the Slack Audit Logs API

frequency.description: Seconds to wait between two collections of new events
frequency.title: Frequency

limit.description: Maximum number of events fetched per request to Slack (Slack caps this at 9999)
limit.title: Limit

ratelimit_per_minute.description: Maximum requests sent to Slack per minute. Slack allows 50 for the whole organization, shared with your other Slack apps
ratelimit_per_minute.title: Ratelimit Per Minute

timebuffer.description: Seconds to wait before collecting a new event, so that events Slack publishes with a delay are not missed
timebuffer.title: Timebuffer

lookback_seconds.description: How far back in time the very first collection goes, in seconds. Ignored once the connector has collected at least once
lookback_seconds.title: Lookback Seconds

excluded_actions.description: Slack actions to drop instead of forwarding, for example file_downloaded. Leave empty to collect everything. An action added here stops being collected from now on and cannot be recovered later without re-collecting the whole period
excluded_actions.title: Excluded Actions
